## What changed

Describe the user-visible or data-methodology change.

## Evidence

Link the source, query, transaction evidence, or reproducible test supporting
the change.

## Metric state

- [ ] Raw observation
- [ ] Resolved entity or service
- [ ] Quality-adjusted classification
- [ ] Interface or documentation only

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Source, formula, window, freshness, and limitations remain visible
- [ ] New upstream material includes its licence or access terms
- [ ] No secrets, personal customer data, or third-party branding were added

## Relationships and credit

List protocol teams, researchers, or contributors whose public evidence made
this change possible. Link the relevant issue or discussion so the decision
history remains visible.

## Remaining limitations

Describe known gaps, possible double counting, or confidence constraints.
